async def act(page):
    # Click on the 'Sample Page' link to navigate to a page that might have a search bar
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="Sample Page").click()
    # Wait for the page to load after navigation
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # After navigation, locate the search bar using accessibility roles
    # First, try to find a searchbox role
    search_bar = page.get_by_role("searchbox")
    if await search_bar.count() == 0:
        # If no searchbox, try to find an element with name containing 'search' or similar
        search_bar = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Search")
    if await search_bar.count() == 0:
        # Fallback to any textbox with placeholder indicating search
        search_bar = page.get_by_role("textbox").filter(has=page.get_by_text("Search", exact=False))
    # Fill the search bar with 'Tracing'
    await search_bar.fill("Tracing")
    # Submit the search by pressing Enter
    await search_bar.press("Enter")
    # Wait for search results to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Identify search results using accessibility roles
    # Look for result items, e.g., in articles or links
    results = page.get_by_role("article").get_by_role("link")
    if await results.count() == 0:
        # Fallback to all links if no articles found
        results = page.get_by_role("link")
    # Click on the second result (index 1 since zero-based)
    await results.nth(1).click()
    # Wait for the page to load after clicking the result
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
